description.en: Impeccable's frontend design system as one DSH skill: 24 playbooks (shape, critique, audit, polish, typeset, layout, animate ...), the craft floor, four surface modes, and a mapping of every upstream engine command onto DSH-native actions. Pure skill plugin, no binary, no client UI, works offline.
description.zh: 把 Impeccable 前端设计体系做成一个 DSH 技能：24 个设计剧本（shape、critique、audit、polish、typeset、layout、animate 等）、craft-floor 质量底线、四种界面模式，并附每个上游引擎命令的 DSH 原生替代映射。纯技能插件，无二进制、无客户端 UI，离线可用。
